recall_at_10.rationale: Calibration split's observed Recall@10 bootstrap CI lower bound (95%, seed 0, 2000 resamples) was 0.7916666666666666 on n=24 answerable queries; set as the frozen minimum acceptable aggregate Recall@10 for the final-test run.

ndcg_at_10.rationale: Calibration split's observed nDCG@10 bootstrap CI lower bound (95%, seed 0, 2000 resamples) was 0.5658406074155423 on n=24 answerable queries; set as the frozen minimum acceptable aggregate nDCG@10 for the final-test run.

abstention.finding: baseline abstention recall = 0; constant non-abstaining behavior on dev+calibration
abstention.detail: Confusion matrix is TP=0, FP=0 on BOTH dev (11 FN/60) and calibration (6 FN/30): index::search never returned SearchOutcome::NotPresent for any of the 17 abstain-expected queries across both splits. Precision and F1 are mathematically undefined (zero denominator, correctly reported as null, never as 0.0). Recall is exactly 0.0 with CI [0.0, 0.0]. No meaningful precision/recall/F1 threshold can be calibrated from a constant classifier. This is a property of the B1 deterministic trigram+BM25 baseline on this corpus, not a runner defect (confirmed by independent review, continuity d202yy/m5mu).

bootstrap.ci_method: percentile bootstrap, 2.5th/97.5th percentile over resampled means, deterministic given the same seed (SplitMix64 PRNG, non-cryptographic, hand-rolled in crates/api/src/metrics.rs)
bootstrap.low_confidence_note: Any breakdown group with fewer than 5 contributing queries (answerable count for recall/nDCG groups, valid-resample count for abstention precision/recall/F1) is flagged low_confidence: true in the per-run reports rather than silently reporting a CI computed from too few samples.

metric_formulas.recall_at_10: |relevant_note_ids ∩ top_10_retrieved_note_ids| / |relevant_note_ids|, true fractional recall, never a 0/1 hit indicator. An answerable query returning SearchOutcome::NotPresent is scored as if it retrieved nothing (Recall@10 = 0.0), never excluded from aggregation.
metric_formulas.hit_at_10: 1 if any relevant note appears in the top 10, else 0 — diagnostic only, never substituted for recall_at_10 or used in any threshold.
metric_formulas.ndcg_at_10: gain(rel) = 2^rel - 1; DCG@10 = sum_{i=1}^{10} gain(rel_i) / log2(i + 1), where rel_i is the graded_relevance value (0, 1, or 2; 0 if the retrieved note has no graded_relevance entry) of the note at rank i among the top 10 results; IDCG@10 = the same formula applied to the query's own graded_relevance values sorted descending and truncated to 10; nDCG@10 = DCG@10 / IDCG@10.
metric_formulas.abstention_confusion_matrix: Binary classification of 'is there evidence for this query': ground truth = label row's abstain_expected; prediction = index::search returned SearchOutcome::NotPresent. TP = abstain_expected and NotPresent (correct abstention); TN = answerable and Matches (correct answer); FP = answerable but NotPresent (a missed real answer); FN = abstain_expected but Matches (a false 'evidence exists'). precision = TP/(TP+FP), recall = TP/(TP+FN), f1 = 2*precision*recall/(precision+recall) — each is null, never 0.0, when its denominator is zero. accuracy = (TP+TN)/(TP+TN+FP+FN).
metric_formulas.protocol_reference: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-14-b3-metric-runner-design.md (B3.3/B3.4 design, approved with corrections, continuity d202yy) and docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-14-b3-metric-runner.md (implementation plan). Both are committed in this repository and do not depend on external state; the formulas above are copied verbatim from that design so this frozen-config.json remains self-contained even if those docs are later edited.

hard_rule: Any change to retrieval_config, thresholds, bootstrap seed/resamples, or metric_formulas made AFTER reading any final-test (B3.5) result invalidates that final-test run as independent evidence for this configuration. A changed configuration requires a new freeze (a new frozen-config.json, or a new version of this one with the change and its date recorded), and any final-test run already read under the old configuration must be disclosed as having preceded the change, never silently superseded.
